def gini(arr):

import json, math

def canonical_t1t5(path, label):
    data = json.load(open(path))
    profiles = data.get("profiles", data)
    deltas = []
    for layer_k in profiles:
        if not layer_k.isdigit():
            continue
        layer = profiles[layer_k]
        for head_k in layer:
            if not head_k.isdigit():
                continue
            entry = layer[head_k]
            q = entry.get("quantization", entry)
            d2 = q.get("2", q.get(2, 0.0))
            deltas.append(float(d2))
    deltas.sort(reverse=True)
    n = len(deltas)
    n5 = max(1, int(n * 0.05))
    total = sum(deltas)
    top5_sum = sum(deltas[:n5])
    top1 = deltas[0]
    t1t5 = top1 / top5_sum if top5_sum > 0 else 0
    top1_share = top1 / total if total > 0 else 0
    conc = top5_sum / total if total > 0 else 0
